ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to restrict the user from editing or creating Rebate Program Member for Under Revision or Approved Sales Agreement.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , NOT( OR( AND( ISCHANGED( MemberStatus ) , ISPICKVAL( MemberStatus , 'Active') , ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Activated') ), AND( ISCHANGED( MemberStatus ) , ISPICKVAL( MemberStatus , 'Inactive') , ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Expired') ) ) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.Status , 'Cancelled')), OR( ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.PMC_SS_ApprovalStatus__c , 'Approved'), ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.PMC_SS_SalesAgreement__r.PMC_SS_ApprovalStatus__c , 'Under Revision') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rebate Program Members can’t be created/edited at this stage. Please Amend the Sales Agreement to make revisions to Rebate Program Members.
